text: Sorry if this is a waste of your time. I'm a foster carer, the baby with me is 5 months old. He's 38.1 tonight. He's teething I'm fairly sure, drooling loads, gnawing on everything he can grab, and one cheek is bright red. His eczema has flared as well, the dry itchy patches behind his knees and on his tummy. I did the glass thing on a couple of the red bits and they went pale straight away. His neck seems fine too, he's been looking down at his feet and grabbing his toes. I just wasn't sure whether 38.1 at his age means he needs seeing or whether it's the teeth
